pages.name: QGD: Chigorin, 3.Nf3 Bg4 4.Nc3
pages.notes: Overview and plans 2-3 called ...Bg4 a pin (the e2-pawn blocks it); plan 4 recaptured on f3 with the queen through the e2-pawn and wrote gxf3 before ...Bxf3. Rewrote overview and plans 2-4. British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Chigorin Defense
pages.notes: Plan 3 named ...Bxc3 with the f8-bishop shut in and said it opens the b-file for Black's rook. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling elsewhere (Chigorin Defence).

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Chigorin Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote the centre as a d4-e4 route; plan 4 called ...Bg4 a pin on a knight that is not yet on f3. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Chigorin Defense, Exchange Variation, Costa's Line
pages.notes: Plan 3 developed Nf3 although the g1-knight is on e2 and castled with the bishop on f1 (first rewrite with g3/Bg2 rejected as unconfirmed; fixed to Nxd4, Be2 and O-O and re-accepted). British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Chigorin Defense, Main Line
pages.notes: Overview called ...Bg4 a pin (the e2-pawn blocks it); plan 2 wrote gxf3 before ...Bxf3. Rewrote overview and plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Chigorin Defense, Tartakower Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 3 invented threats against f2 and an exposed white king; plan 4 developed Be2 with the e-pawn still on e2 and castled with it. Rewrote plans 3-4; British spelling.

pages.name: QGD: Albin, 4.Nf3 Nc6 5.a3 a5
pages.notes: Plan 1 named b6 as a White target; plan 2 made b5 a Black outpost (first rewrite making b4 a home rejected, since a3 covers b4; fixed and re-accepted). Rewrote plans 1-2.

pages.name: QGD: Albin, Alapin, 5...Bg4
pages.notes: Overview called ...Bg4 a pin; plan 1 said ...Bxf3 creates kingside weaknesses, though the d2-knight recaptures; plan 2 broke the pin with g4 onto the bishop's square. Rewrote overview and plans 1-2; British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Albin Countergambit, Balogh Variation
pages.notes: Overview called the Balogh, Black's 5...Qe7, a White approach; plan 1 gave ...f5; plan 2 routed a knight Nf1-e3 with the f1-bishop at home. Rewrote all.

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Declined: Albin Countergambit, Lasker Trap
pages.notes: Plan 1 relied on a d4-pawn that has already captured on e3. Rewrote plan 1.
